summary: Independent implementation review approves fixed subject 4b8fcfd4aab0fbc88d567df5204173e27e2f10ab against the frozen specification, recomputed exact native implementation context and matching canonical evidence digest. The core change remains confined to the existing private close check: standard Git rev-list parent inspection, complete SHA and output validation, at least two parents, a non-null subject and the unchanged commits_are_ancestral helper proving base-to-subject-to-at-least-one-incoming-parent. Ordinary commits, unrelated or first-parent-only candidates, invalid ancestry, malformed metadata and unavailable Git facts are rejected before the existing close transition. Equality, later governance commits, a valid incoming parent after the second and candidates also contained by the first parent remain supported. Existing state, result, repository identity, event payload, loading and recovery behavior remain unchanged; consistent-task rejection tests compare complete task-directory bytes and success preserves HEAD and branch. The independently identified null-subject TypeError is closed by a local null guard and actual CLI regression, without changing the shared Git helper or Schema. Original failing regression and null failure logs are retained. The final integration and AUTO end-to-end fixtures use actual commit graphs; quickstart accurately states local and external proof boundaries. Native V1 evidence binds this exact subject and passes all ten required checks: 3858 tests in 899.73 seconds, core and analysis total coverage 89 and 97 percent, core diff coverage 100 percent, no analysis source changes, plus Ruff, format and strict mypy. Evidence digest, required logs and whitespace were independently checked. Four targeted boundary cases were independently rerun and passed in 7.55 seconds outside the sandbox after an initial sandbox fixture Git-init permission failure; that environment failure remains recorded and did not exercise close. No new module, dependency, Policy, authority, generic Git wrapper, network operation or historical MERGED revalidation was added. Local Git view consistency does not authenticate a PR, target branch, remote completion, required CI or tamper resistance; final Gate, required remote CI and publication remain separate. Real scoring, automatic review arrangement, host connections and observation start remain paused. No open implementation findings remain.
